description: Original completed settlement delivery transfer receiving, retained customer workspace, Applications configuration and native destination browser ownership.

commandDescriptions.delivery-receive: Receive or reopen a complete original settlement transfer and inspect the customer's same retained destination workspace.
commandDescriptions.delivery-receiving-configure: Prepare the received delivery workspace for original Applications and retain exact save/start requests.
commandDescriptions.delivery-receiving-workspace: Open the received SF98 destination browser through the original managed Applications lifecycle.
